text:
morgan: quick heads-up — ISO fieldwork is next Tue/Wed. Need to lock auditlog ownership for KMS event types. Who owns the ingest + mapping for key lifecycle events? cc @alex @jamie
alex: I can take the ingest pipeline changes (s3 path + parser). Will open PR today.
priya: I can own mapping to the internal audit schema (fields/ids). Need sample event shapes.
alex: sample path: s3://redwood-audit/kms/partition=2026-03-18/
Parser draft:```
jq '.records[] | {evt: .type, key_id: .detail.keyId, ts: .time, error_code: .detail.errorCode, status: .detail.status}'
```
jamie: SIEM side — I need to know which events should trigger alerts (key rotation failures, unauthorized create). Priya can we add 'severity' in mapping?
priya: yes, plan: severity -> [info|warning|critical] based on error codes. alex can you include error_code and status?
alex: will include error_code + status. Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/infralog/pull/482 — draft.
morgan: thanks. Also, auditors asked for evidence of retention policy. @jamie can you confirm retention TTL on audit bucket and any lifecycle rules? Need export by Monday.
jamie: retention is 7 years, lifecycle rule transitions to glacier after 90d. I'll paste policy and ping infra-bot to generate an evidence snapshot.
infra-bot: Evidence snapshot scheduled: job id 4553. ETA 15m. Output: /tmp/evidence/iso-2026/kms-audit-snapshot.tar.gz
alex: added unit tests for parser, left TODO for timezone normalization. ping @priya for review.
priya: on it, will review tonight. Also, need owners list in the evidence doc — @morgan can you confirm approvals?
morgan: approved owners: morgan, alex, priya, jamie. I'll add in the doc and sign off once PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-20T02:00Z. Will run canary smoke tests. Notify #incidents if failures.
jamie: noted. I'll watch canary and update thread. If anything breaks, I'll create incident and tag @sec-oncall.
morgan: perfect. if no objections, let's converge: alex owns ingest PR, priya owns mapping + schema, jamie owns retention/evidence + SIEM rules. I'll coordinate with auditors and follow up Monday morning. thanks everyone :tada:
